items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: The night, the tribute to John Hammond with Benny Goodman and George Benson and Benny Carter and all those on the air, --

ctx.x: But the managers all wanted his name on it. But he insisted he wanted his name on nothing I did, because he said that style will cut through later years and

the critics will know it's his style and I want mine on the cover. But, Stanley, I just want to say one thing. The night, the tribute to John Hammond with Benny Goodman and George Benson and Benny Carter and all those on the air, --
